From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: bank details and invoice/PO mapping for payment routing

Hi Alyssa,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood — excited to get Northscale live for vendor payments. To complete finance onboarding and ensure timely remittances, can you confirm the following details and attach the standard forms (W-9, ACH authorization, and a bank letter with routing/account confirmation)?

What we need from you:
- Legal payee name (as it appears on bank account)
- Bank routing number (ABA) and account number (you can mask intermediate digits, provide last 4)
- Account type (checking/savings)
- EFT remit-to formatting: what string should appear in the remit field (example: "NORTHSCALE LOGISTICS / RemitRef: {PO}")
- Preferred invoice labeling: please confirm the field we should look for for PO mapping (suggested: "PO: ####" in invoice description)
- Any special instructions for international wires (if applicable)

If you can drop the forms in reply, finance will schedule micro-deposits to verify the account. Once verified we’ll map incoming invoices to PO numbers and enable automated remittance on payment.

Thanks — copying FinOps if they have questions.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
